paragraphs.en: download weights(.ckpt or .safetensors or .gguf). For example
paragraphs.zh: 下载权重（.ckpt 或 .safetensors 或 .gguf）。例如

paragraphs.en: curl -L -O https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5/resolve/main/v1-5-pruned-emaonly.safetensors Generate an image with just one command ./bin/sd-cli -m ../models/v1-5-pruned-emaonly.safetensors -p " a lovely cat " For detailed command-line arguments, check out cli doc .
paragraphs.zh: curl -L -O https://huggingface.co/stable-diffusion-v1-5/stable-diffusion-v1-5/resolve/main/v1-5-pruned-emaonly.safetensors 只需一条命令即可生成图像 ./bin/sd-cli -m ../models/v1-5-pruned-emaonly.safetensors -p " a lovely cat " 详细的命令行参数请查看 cli 文档。

paragraphs.en: These projects wrap stable-diffusion.cpp for easier use in other languages/frameworks.
paragraphs.zh: 这些项目封装了 stable-diffusion.cpp，以便在其他语言/框架中更方便地使用。

paragraphs.en: These projects use stable-diffusion.cpp as a backend for their image generation.
paragraphs.zh: 这些项目使用 stable-diffusion.cpp 作为其图像生成的后端。

paragraphs.en: Thank you to all the people who have already contributed to stable-diffusion.cpp!
paragraphs.zh: 感谢所有已经为 stable-diffusion.cpp 做出贡献的人们！
